site_model.description: Mid-size Shopify-style clothing store with a cookie consent modal and a mobile hamburger nav.

journeys.name: Find a product
journeys.goal: From the home page, open the 'All products' collection and open the first product's page.

journeys.name: Add to cart
journeys.goal: Open any product page, add it to the cart, and open the cart page.

journeys.name: Reach checkout
journeys.goal: With one item in the cart, proceed to checkout and stop at the payment step. Do not pay.

findings.description: On mobile, the consent modal intercepts every click and its accept button is off-screen; the agent never reaches the collection page.
findings.proposed_fix: Make the consent modal's Accept button visible in the mobile viewport, first in DOM order, and give the dialog role="dialog" with aria-label="Cookie consent".
